title: Burst Tactician — compact policy composer for reserve pools
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a compact, operator-focused composer for configuring burst and autoscale policies on Dedicated GPU pools. The interface must enable rapid adjustments (hysteresis, burst windows, soft caps, cost caps), show immediate cost/latency trade-offs, provide safe presets, and include a simulation preview that projects 1h/6h/24h estimated spend and SLO risk. Target placement: Reserve Pool Detail > Actions > Configure Burst. Mobile and small-panel variants should be considered for on-call usage.
decisions: Ship a compact single-panel composer rather than a multi-step wizard to reduce friction for operators.
Expose three safety-presets by default: conservative, balanced, aggressive — user can create/customize presets.
Include an embedded preflight simulator (synthetic load model) that shows expected latency P50/P95 and estimated token spend for 1h/6h/24h horizons.
Keep advanced knobs (kernel-level batch tuning) behind an 'advanced' toggle to avoid confusion for most users.
Default burst windows should include a 15m sliding window and a 1h peak allowance for predictable short surges.
Cost preview will display ΔUSD and percent change vs. baseline; do not auto-apply changes without explicit confirmation.
Add an audit log link and require role with 'pool:modify' to save policy changes in Private deployments.
next_steps: Incorporate eng feedback on telemetry sample rates (ENG-5412) and update simulator assumptions — due 2026-03-14.
Run 5 unmoderated usability sessions with Platform On-call and two customer admins — schedule by 2026-03-18.
Finalize ARIA/accessibility spec and keyboard flows for compact panel — owner: Priya Sharma.
Prepare design handoff package and component tokens for implementation (Figma dev file and tokens JSON).
